editionLabel: English refresh edition · 2021 credits, eight voting dials
firstPlayerRule: Whoever comes up with a clue for a card first becomes the opening storyteller.
houseFallback: If nobody wants to offer the first clue, your group can agree to choose a storyteller randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: After a turn, the storyteller role moves to the player on the current storyteller’s left.
